onboarding.subtitle: To get started, choose a transcription model

parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2.name: Parakeet V2
parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2.description: English only. The best model for English speakers.

moonshine-base.name: Moonshine Base
moonshine-base.description: Very fast, English only. Handles accents well.

moonshine-small-streaming-en.name: Moonshine V2 Small
moonshine-small-streaming-en.description: Fast, English only. Good balance of speed and accuracy.

breeze-asr.name: Breeze ASR
breeze-asr.description: Optimized for Taiwanese Mandarin. Code-switching support.

sense-voice-int8.name: SenseVoice
sense-voice-int8.description: Very fast. Chinese, English, Japanese, Korean, Cantonese.

gigaam-v3-e2e-ctc.name: GigaAM v3
gigaam-v3-e2e-ctc.description: Russian speech recognition. Fast and accurate.

canary-180m-flash.name: Canary 180M Flash
canary-180m-flash.description: Very fast. English, German, Spanish, French. Supports translation.

canary-1b-v2.name: Canary 1B v2
canary-1b-v2.description: Accurate multilingual. 25 European languages. Supports translation.

cohere-int8.name: Cohere
cohere-int8.description: A large, slower, but very accurate multilingual model.

permissions.title: Permissions Required
permissions.description: Vox needs a couple of permissions to work properly.

microphone.title: Microphone Access
microphone.description: Required to hear your voice for transcription.

accessibility.title: Accessibility Access
accessibility.description: Required to type transcribed text into your applications.

errors.checkFailed: Failed to check permissions. Please try again.
errors.requestFailed: Failed to request permission. Please try again.

capabilities.streaming: Shows live transcription as you speak

shortcut.title: Vox Shortcuts
shortcut.description: Configure keyboard shortcuts to trigger speech-to-text recording

transcribe.name: Transcribe Shortcut
transcribe.description: The keyboard shortcut to record and transcribe your voice.

cancel.name: Cancel Shortcut
cancel.description: The keyboard shortcut to cancel the current recording.

transcribe_with_post_process.name: Post-Processing Hotkey
transcribe_with_post_process.description: Optional: A dedicated hotkey that always applies AI post-processing to your transcription.

converse.name: Conversation Shortcut
converse.description: The keyboard shortcut to start or stop a hands-free conversation.

errors.reset: Failed to reset shortcut to original value

language.title: Language
language.description: Select the language for speech recognition. Auto will automatically determine the language, while selecting a specific language can improve accuracy for that language.

shortcutActivation.title: Shortcut Behavior
shortcutActivation.description: Choose how the transcribe shortcut starts and stops recording.

descriptions.hold_or_toggle: Hold to record or tap to toggle
descriptions.push_to_talk: Records while you hold the shortcut
descriptions.toggle: Tap the shortcut to start recording, tap again to stop

models.title: Transcription Models
models.description: Select a transcription model or download additional models. Different models offer varying levels of accuracy and speed.
models.deleteConfirm: Are you sure you want to delete {{modelName}}? You will need to download it again to use it.
models.deleteActiveConfirm: {{modelName}} is your active model. Deleting it will stop transcriptions until you select a new model. Are you sure?

filters.streaming: Filter models that support live streaming transcription
filters.translation: Filter models that support translation to English

rescan.label: Rescan
rescan.tooltip: Rescan for models added to the models folder or Hugging Face cache outside Vox

channel.title: Input Channel
channel.description: Select which input channel to record from. Use this if your audio interface has multiple inputs.

audioFeedback.label: Audio Feedback
audioFeedback.description: Play sound when recording starts and stops

outputDevice.title: Output Device
outputDevice.description: Select your preferred audio output device for feedback sounds

volume.title: Volume
volume.description: Adjust the volume of audio feedback sounds

experimentalToggle.label: Experimental Features
experimentalToggle.description: Enable experimental features that are still in development.

memory.label: Memory
memory.description: Lets Vox remember facts you dictate (e.g. "remember that I prefer tea") in a local, offline database. Dictation is pasted as usual either way; remembered facts are only stored for future recall, never sent anywhere.
memory.empty: No facts remembered yet. Say "remember that..." while dictating, or add one above.

listeningMode.title: Listening Mode
listeningMode.description: Choose one way for Vox to listen without a hotkey: Wake Word listens only for a trigger phrase; Ambient Mode transcribes nearby audio into a short-lived, RAM-only buffer and acts only when addressed. Only one mode can be active at a time.

ambientMode.label: Ambient Mode
ambientMode.description: Continuously transcribes nearby audio into a short-lived, RAM-only buffer that is never written to disk. Vox acts only when it detects that you addressed your wake name (for example, "Vox, what time is it?").
ambientMode.disabledByWakeWord: Turn off Wake Word to enable Ambient Mode.

wakeWord.label: Wake Word
wakeWord.description: Opt-in, continuous background listening for a wake phrase (currently "hey jarvis" as a placeholder -- a dedicated "Hey Vox" model is a future improvement). When enabled, saying the wake phrase auto-starts a normal dictation recording, same as pressing the hotkey. Mutually exclusive with actively using the hotkey at any given instant (whichever is active wins); both can be enabled as features at the same time.
wakeWord.disabledByAmbientMode: Turn off Ambient Mode to enable Wake Word.
wakeWord.downloadFailedTitle: Wake word model couldn't be downloaded

voiceCommands.label: Voice Commands
voiceCommands.description: Lets phrases like "open Safari" or "open Downloads" open the real app/folder instead of being pasted as text. Only recognized, deterministic commands run — anything else falls back to normal dictation.

voiceShortcuts.title: Voice Shortcuts
voiceShortcuts.description: Say a phrase exactly as written to run its action. Shortcuts work only while Voice Commands is on. Folder shortcuts open folders only, not files. App shortcuts require the app to be installed.
voiceShortcuts.empty: No shortcuts yet. Add one to map a spoken phrase to a URL, folder, or app.

voiceMediaControls.label: Media Controls
voiceMediaControls.description: Phrases like "pause", "next track" or "volume 40" control Spotify or Music and the system volume instead of being pasted. Only exact whole phrases are matched, but a standalone dictated "pause", "skip" or "mute" will be treated as a command while this is on. Requires Voice Commands. macOS may ask you to allow Automation the first time.

agentBridge.label: Agent Bridge
agentBridge.description: When a spoken command isn't recognized, send the transcript to a locally-configured CLI agent and show its reply as a suggestion. Nothing is sent anywhere unless you configure a binary below.
agentBridge.binaryPathDescription: Full path to the CLI agent executable to invoke. Leave empty to keep Agent Bridge inactive even if the toggle above is on.

agentContext.title: Conversation Context
agentContext.description: When on, your last few exchanges with the agent and any remembered facts are sent to the agent along with each request. The conversation is kept in memory only, and is cleared when you turn this off or restart Vox. A remembered fact or reply containing text that looks like instructions could influence the agent.
agentContext.clearFailedToast: Could not clear the conversation history.

tts.label: Spoken Replies
tts.description: Speaks agent replies and short confirmation or failure phrases aloud. Spoken output is audible to anyone nearby. Speech is paused while you are recording and never plays into your microphone on purpose.
tts.voiceDescription: Name of a system voice (for example "Samantha"). Leave empty to use the system default.
tts.voiceListDescription: Choose one of the voices installed on this Mac. Leave on System default to use the system voice.
tts.rateDescription: How fast spoken replies are read, in words per minute.
tts.testDescription: Speak a short sample with the current voice and rate.
tts.testPhrase: This is how spoken replies will sound.

composer.title: Spoken reply style
composer.description: Rewrites each agent reply into a short spoken sentence before Vox reads it aloud. Off speaks the reply text as it is.
composer.modeDescription: Off speaks replies as they are. Model asks a configured provider. Command runs a program you choose.
composer.providerDescription: Provider from your post-processing settings that writes the spoken sentence.
composer.providersLoadFailed: Could not load the provider list.
composer.modelDescription: Model name sent to the provider. Saved when you leave the field or press Enter.
composer.dataFlowModel: Sent to {{provider}} at {{baseUrl}}: the agent reply, the style text, and what you asked if that option is on.
composer.latencyModel: Model mode calls the provider directly and is usually much faster than command mode.
composer.commandPathDescription: Absolute path to a command-line agent program. Vox starts it for every reply.
composer.commandArgsDescription: Arguments placed before the prompt. Keep them free of secrets.
composer.promptFlagDescription: Flag that comes before the prompt text. Leave empty for -p.
composer.ackLabel: I understand the risks of running this command
composer.ackDescription: Required before command mode can run. Changing the path, the arguments or the flag asks for it again.
composer.ackWarning: Running this command executes a program with your user permissions every time Vox speaks a reply. The reply text and, if enabled, what you asked are passed to it as an argument. Text inside a reply could steer an agent into using tools or sending data, and Vox cannot enforce a tool-free mode. Prefer a configuration with no tools and no network access. Do not put secrets in the arguments: settings can appear in debug logs.

readiness.needs_acknowledgement: Needs your acknowledgement before it can run

composer.dataFlowCommand: Command: {{path}}. The reply text, and what you asked if that option is on, are passed to it as one argument.
composer.latencyCommand: Command mode starts a program for every reply. A reply usually takes 15 to 20 seconds.
composer.dataFlowUtterance: What you asked is sent along with each reply to the composer.
composer.styleDescription: Short instruction for how the spoken sentence should sound, for example: brief and friendly.
composer.timeoutDescription: How long to wait for the composer before speaking the fallback.
composer.timeoutRange: Enter a whole number of seconds from 2 to 60.
composer.sendUtteranceDescription: Also send your spoken request to the composer, so the sentence can answer it. Off sends only the agent reply and the style.
composer.fallbackDescription: What Vox speaks when the composer times out or fails.
composer.previewDescription: Compose a sample sentence with the current settings. Nothing is spoken.

status.not_configured: Not set up yet, spoke the fallback.
status.needs_acknowledgement: Command not acknowledged, spoke the fallback.
status.backend_error: The composer failed, spoke the fallback.
status.output_too_large: The composer reply was too long, spoke the fallback.
status.empty: The composer returned nothing, spoke the fallback.
status.unparseable: The composer reply could not be read, spoke the fallback.
status.superseded: A newer reply replaced this one.

voice.label: Natural voice
voice.description: Pick the voice used for natural speech.

natural.previewText: Hello! This is how the natural voice sounds.

model.label: Natural voice model
model.notInstalled: Not downloaded. One-time download of about {{size}}; speech is generated on this device and your text is never sent anywhere.
model.needed: Download the model to use the natural voice. Until then the system voice is used.

failure.banner: The natural voice stopped working, so the system voice is being used.
failure.load: The model could not be loaded.
failure.sink: The audio output failed. Check your output device.

notice.firstSpeech: The first sentence can take a few seconds while the model loads.
notice.limitations: English only. Sentences in other scripts are spoken by the system voice.

lazyStreamClose.label: Keep Mic Open Between Transcriptions
lazyStreamClose.description: Keeps the microphone stream open for 30 seconds after recording stops, reducing latency for back-to-back transcriptions. May degrade Bluetooth audio quality while active.

transcribe.title: transcribe.cpp Acceleration
transcribe.description: Hardware acceleration for transcribe.cpp (Whisper-family) models. Auto uses GPU if available (Metal on macOS, Vulkan on Windows/Linux).

ort.title: ONNX Acceleration
ort.description: Hardware acceleration for ONNX models (Parakeet, Canary, Moonshine, etc.). DirectML on Windows is experimental. Models may fail to transcribe.

startHidden.label: Start Hidden
startHidden.description: Launch to system tray without opening the window.

autostart.label: Launch on Startup
autostart.description: Automatically start Vox when you log in to your computer.

showTrayIcon.label: Show Tray Icon
showTrayIcon.description: Display the Vox icon in the system tray.

style.title: Overlay
style.description: Choose the recording overlay: None hides it, Minimal shows a compact pill, Live shows transcription in real time as you speak (streaming-capable models only — look for the Streaming badge in the model picker). On Linux 'None' is recommended.

position.title: Overlay Position
position.description: Where the overlay appears on screen during recording and transcription.

pasteMethod.title: Paste Method
pasteMethod.description: Choose how text is inserted. Direct: simulates typing via system input. None: skips paste, only updates history/clipboard.

typingTool.title: Typing Tool
typingTool.description: Choose which Linux typing tool to use for Direct paste method. Auto will automatically detect and use the best available tool for your system.

clipboardHandling.title: Clipboard Handling
clipboardHandling.description: Don't Modify Clipboard preserves your current clipboard contents after transcription. Copy to Clipboard leaves the transcription result in your clipboard after pasting.

autoSubmit.title: Auto Submit
autoSubmit.description: Automatically send the selected key combination after text insertion. Cmd+Enter applies on macOS, while Windows/Linux use Super+Enter.

translateToEnglish.label: Translate to English
translateToEnglish.description: Automatically translate speech from other languages to English during transcription.

modelUnload.title: Unload Model
modelUnload.description: Automatically free GPU/CPU memory when the model hasn't been used for the specified time

customWords.title: Custom Words
customWords.description: Help supported models recognize names and specialized terms. Fuzzy correction is currently limited to words using A–Z and numbers.

voiceActivityDetection.title: Voice Activity Detection
voiceActivityDetection.description: Filter silence from recordings. Streaming-capable models use a longer VAD tail; disabling VAD records raw audio.

vadBackend.title: Voice Activity Backend
vadBackend.description: Choose the detector used to filter silence. Earshot is experimental; switch back to Silero if speech is clipped or noise is retained.

fillerWordRemoval.title: Remove Filler Words
fillerWordRemoval.description: Removes common hesitation words from transcriptions. Turn off to keep them.

chineseScript.title: Chinese Script
chineseScript.description: Writes Mandarin and Cantonese transcriptions in Simplified or Traditional characters. Other languages are left unchanged.

appleIntelligence.unavailable: Apple Intelligence is not available on this device. Requires an Apple Silicon Mac running macOS Tahoe (26.0) or later with Apple Intelligence enabled in System Settings.

baseUrl.title: Base URL
baseUrl.description: API base URL for the selected provider. Only the custom provider can be edited.

apiKey.title: API Key
apiKey.description: API key for the selected provider.

model.title: Model
model.descriptionCustom: Provide the model identifier expected by your custom endpoint.
model.descriptionDefault: Choose a model exposed by the selected provider.

prompts.title: Prompt

selectedPrompt.title: Selected Prompt
selectedPrompt.description: Select a template for refining transcriptions or create a new one. Use ${output} inside the prompt text to reference the captured transcript.

prompts.promptInstructionsPlaceholder: Write the instructions to run after transcription. Example: Improve grammar and clarity for the following text: ${output}
prompts.promptTip: Tip: Use ${output} to insert the transcribed text in your prompt.
prompts.selectToEdit: Select a prompt above to view and edit its details.
prompts.createFirst: Click 'Create New Prompt' above to create your first post-processing prompt.

history.title: History
history.empty: No transcriptions yet. Start recording to build your history!
history.searchError: Failed to search history. Please try again.
history.copyError: Failed to copy transcription to clipboard.
history.deleteError: Failed to delete entry. Please try again.
history.retranscribeError: Failed to re-transcribe. Please try again.
history.transcriptionFailed: Transcription failed. You can re-transcribe using the retry icon.

logDirectory.title: Log Directory
logDirectory.description: Location where log files are stored

liveLogs.title: Live Logs
liveLogs.description: Stream application logs in real time to diagnose issues without opening the log file. Only logs emitted while this panel is open are shown; respects the Log Level setting above.
liveLogs.empty: Waiting for logs… Entries appear here as the app emits them.

updateChecks.label: Check for Updates
updateChecks.description: Automatically check for new versions of Vox

whatsNewPreview.title: Preview What's New
whatsNewPreview.description: Open the latest bundled release note without marking it as seen

onboardingPreview.title: Preview Onboarding
onboardingPreview.description: Preview onboarding screens without changing permissions, models, or completion state

soundTheme.label: Sound Theme
soundTheme.description: Choose a sound theme for recording start and stop feedback

historyLimit.title: History Limit
historyLimit.description: Maximum number of history entries to keep

recordingRetention.title: Auto-Delete Recordings
recordingRetention.description: Automatically delete old recordings to save space

alwaysOnMicrophone.label: Always-On Microphone
alwaysOnMicrophone.description: Keep microphone active for faster response

clamshellMicrophone.title: Clamshell Microphone
clamshellMicrophone.description: Microphone to use when laptop lid is closed

postProcessingToggle.label: Post Processing
postProcessingToggle.description: Enable AI-powered text refinement after transcription

appendTrailingSpace.label: Append Trailing Space
appendTrailingSpace.description: Add a space after pasted transcription

keyboardImplementation.title: Keyboard Implementation
keyboardImplementation.bindingsReset: Keyboard shortcuts were incompatible and reset to defaults

pasteDelay.title: Paste Delay (Before)
pasteDelay.description: Delay (in milliseconds) after copying text, before sending the paste keystroke. Increase if nothing gets pasted.

pasteDelayAfter.title: Paste Delay (After)
pasteDelayAfter.description: Delay (in milliseconds) after the paste keystroke, before restoring your previous clipboard. Increase if your old clipboard content is being pasted instead of the transcription.

holdThreshold.title: Hold Threshold
holdThreshold.description: Auto mode only: how long (in milliseconds) the shortcut must be held before it counts as a hold instead of a tap. Lower if short holds keep leaving recording on; raise if deliberate taps get treated as holds.

reliablePaste.title: Reliable Paste (Beta)
reliablePaste.description: Restore the clipboard only after the target app actually reads the transcription, instead of after a fixed delay. Intended to fix old clipboard content being pasted under system load. Requires a clipboard paste method; macOS and Windows only.

recordingBuffer.title: Extra Recording Buffer
recordingBuffer.description: Extra time (in milliseconds) to keep recording after you release the key, to capture trailing audio. 0 = no extra buffer.

keyboardDiagnostic.title: Keyboard Diagnostic
keyboardDiagnostic.description: Checks whether keyboard events reach Vox. Only event counts are recorded — never which keys you press.
keyboardDiagnostic.running: Listening… press your shortcut a few times (e.g. Option+Space)
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictBlocked: Secure Input is blocking key events — keyed shortcuts cannot work until it is resolved.
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictSuspicious: Modifier events arrived but no key events — something is suppressing keys even though Secure Input reports disabled. Please report this on GitHub.
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictOk: Key events are reaching Vox normally.
keyboardDiagnostic.verdictNoEvents: No events captured — did you press any keys during the test?

whatsNewUpdates.label: Show What's New
whatsNewUpdates.description: Show release notes after Vox updates

appDataDirectory.title: App Data Directory
appDataDirectory.description: Location where Vox stores its data

ggml.title: ggml
ggml.description: High-performance tensor library for on-device machine learning inference
ggml.details: Vox's local speech-to-text is built on transcribe.cpp and ggml. Thanks to the amazing work by Georgi Gerganov and contributors.

realtime.title: Realtime conversation
realtime.intro: Experimental. Every behaviour below is off until you turn it on. Nothing is sent to a remote endpoint unless you enable "Use my own endpoint".

enabled.label: Enable realtime conversation
enabled.description: Turns on the realtime conversation behaviour. When off, the conversation works exactly as before.

speakReplies.label: Speak replies aloud
speakReplies.description: Speaks the conversation's replies out loud. This is the same setting as Spoken Replies.

directEndpoint.label: Use my own endpoint
directEndpoint.description: Send replies to the endpoint you enter below instead of the speech composer settings.

endpoint.label: Endpoint address
endpoint.description: Base address of an Anthropic-style API. Must use https unless it is localhost.

model.label: Model name
model.description: Name of the model to ask.

token.label: Access token
token.description: Pasted by you and stored in Vox settings. It is never shown here and never written to logs.

status.off: Off: turn on the realtime conversation and your own endpoint to use it.
status.ok: Ready: the endpoint, model and token are set.
status.invalid_endpoint: The endpoint address is not valid.
status.needs_https: The endpoint must use https unless it is localhost.

errors.needs_https: Use https for this address (plain http is allowed only for localhost).

streamReply.label: Stream replies
streamReply.description: Show and speak the reply as it is generated instead of waiting for the whole answer.

earlySpeech.label: Speak while the reply streams
earlySpeech.description: Start speaking sentences before the reply finishes. Needs Stream replies.

fastVoice.label: Fast voice engine
fastVoice.description: Use a resident system voice for lower speaking delay (macOS).

ack.label: Spoken acknowledgement
ack.description: Say a short "One moment" when the reply is slow.

prewarm.label: Pre-connect
prewarm.description: Open the connection to the endpoint before your first question.

autoProxy.label: Auto-detect proxy
autoProxy.description: Use the proxy from your environment or login shell when Vox is started from Finder.

proxy.label: Use a manual proxy
proxy.description: Route realtime requests through the proxy address below.

proxyUrl.label: Proxy address
proxyUrl.description: http or https address of the proxy, with a host and port.

timingLog.label: Timing log
timingLog.description: Log per-turn latency numbers only. No text or tokens are logged.

conversationMemory.recordsDescription: Saves a local record of your voice conversations so you can look back at them later. Off by default; nothing is saved unless you turn this on. Redaction of sensitive text is best-effort, so review what is saved. Conversation summaries are generated with the model endpoint your conversation already uses.
conversationMemory.vaultToggleLabel: Also save to my notes vault
conversationMemory.vaultToggleDescription: Also writes each saved conversation as a Markdown note in the vault folder below. Needs Save conversation records on and a vault folder set.
conversationMemory.vaultPathDescription: Full path to the folder inside your notes vault where conversation notes are written. Leave empty to turn off vault saving.
conversationMemory.contextLabel: Use my vault notes as conversation context
conversationMemory.contextDescription: While this is on, the conversation is answer-only: it cannot paste text or open things, and replies start slightly slower, until a confirmation feature exists. Command and agent-bridge backends do not get vault context or model summaries.
conversationMemory.groupDescription: Opt-in records of your conversations, with optional vault notes and vault context.

agentTools.groupDescription: Let the voice assistant read project status and files. Off by default.
agentTools.enabledDescription: Lets the voice assistant read git status, file contents, project names and recent conversations to answer questions. Off by default.
agentTools.guardLabel: Block actions after reading project data
agentTools.guardDescription: Protects against files or web text that try to trick the assistant into pasting or opening things. Turn off to let the assistant act freely. When off, a malicious file you ask about could cause it to paste text or open a link.
agentTools.projectRootsDescription: Folders the assistant may read. Type an absolute path and press Add folder.
agentTools.noProjectRoots: No project folders yet. The assistant cannot read any project until you add one.
agentTools.projectRootsLimit: You can add up to {{max}} project folders.
agentTools.privacyText: When tools are on, file contents and git status are sent to the model. Redaction of sensitive text is best-effort, so review what your project folders contain.

jobs.groupDescription: Let the voice assistant start a coding job in a project folder. Off by default.
jobs.confirmDescription: Vox asks "OK?" aloud before it types, opens something or starts a coding job. Turn off only if you trust every voice command.
jobs.enabledDescription: Lets the voice assistant start your coding CLI on a task inside a project folder you configured. Off by default.
jobs.timeoutDescription: A job is stopped when it runs longer than this. Choose from {{min}} to {{max}} minutes.
jobs.warning: A coding job runs your coding CLI with your account's permissions and environment inside the project folder. The task text is visible to other programs on this computer while it runs.

agents.label: Agent names
agents.description: Names of the coding agents Vox may choose from. Leave empty to always use the default agent.
agents.invalid: Use 1 to 64 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores, starting with a letter or digit.
agents.limit: You can add up to {{max}} agent names.

flag.label: Agent flag
flag.description: The option that passes the chosen agent name to the coding CLI, for example --agent.
flag.invalid: Use one or two dashes, then a letter and up to 31 more letters, digits or dashes. It cannot be the prompt flag.

ask.label: Ask an agent and speak a summary
ask.description: After an ask job finishes, Vox sends a redacted excerpt (at most 8 KiB) of the agent's output to the model gateway you configured and speaks a short summary. Off by default.

footer.portableUpdateMessage: Portable installs cannot be updated automatically. Download the installer for your system below, run it, and install to the same folder — your Data/ folder (settings, models, recordings) is kept in place.
footer.portableUpdateBrowseMessage: Portable installs cannot be updated automatically. Download the latest version for your system from GitHub Releases and install it to the same folder — your Data/ folder (settings, models, recordings) is kept in place.

dialog.title: Update Vox
dialog.explanation: Updating builds the latest code from GitHub main in your local checkout using the repository's own update script. A Terminal window opens, the build takes several minutes, and Vox restarts when it finishes.
dialog.blockerUnknown: Could not verify that the checkout is ready to update.

accessibility.permissionsDescription: Vox needs accessibility permissions to type transcribed text.

micPermissionDenied.generic: Microphone access was denied by the operating system. Please grant microphone permission in your system settings.
micPermissionDenied.windows: Enable microphone access in Settings → Privacy & security → Microphone (including desktop app access).
micPermissionDenied.macos: Grant microphone access in System Settings → Privacy & Security → Microphone.
micPermissionDenied.linux: Grant microphone access in your system's sound or privacy settings.

errors.noInputDevice: No audio input device was detected. Please connect a microphone or headset and try again.
errors.conversationActive: A conversation is using the microphone. Finish or stop it before dictating.
errors.pasteFailed: Text could not be pasted into the active application.

appLanguage.title: Application Language
appLanguage.description: Change the language of the Vox interface

theme.title: Application Theme
theme.description: Choose whether Vox follows your system theme or stays light, dark, Aurora, or a custom palette you edit yourself

custom.description: Pick any color for each part of the interface

secureInput.recorderBlockedNoCulprit: macOS is temporarily blocking shortcut changes
secureInput.recorderBlocked: Can't record shortcuts right now — macOS Secure Input is blocking key events. Resolve the Secure Input warning first.

end.idle: Stopped after no speech for several turns.
end.not_configured: Spoken replies are not set up. Turn on spoken replies and choose a reply backend.
end.speech_stuck: Speech output got stuck, so the conversation stopped.

section.title: Conversation
section.description: Hands-free conversation: Vox listens, answers aloud, and keeps a short memory of this session.

errors.unknown: Something went wrong with the conversation.

section.silenceDescription: How long Vox waits in silence before it treats your turn as finished.
section.idleTurnsDescription: Vox stops the conversation after this many turns in a row with no speech.
section.contextTurnsDescription: How many recent exchanges are sent to the reply backend. Older turns are dropped and the memory expires with the session.
section.shortcutDescription: Change this in the shortcut settings. Shown here for reference.
section.privacyNote: What you say and Vox's replies are sent to your configured reply backend.
section.wakeWordNote: Wake word and ambient listening must be off while a conversation runs.

voice.title: Voice features
voice.intro: Optional add-ons for hands-free conversation. Each one is off until you turn it on, and each download happens only when you press Download.

state.error: The last attempt did not work.

error.busy: Another model download is already running.
error.corrupt: The downloaded file did not match its expected size or checksum. Download it again.
error.url_not_allowed: The download address is not on the allowed list.
error.download: The download failed. Check your connection and try again.
error.io: The file could not be saved on this computer.
error.unknown: Something went wrong with the model.

smartTurn.heading: Smart turn detection
smartTurn.label: Smart turn detection
smartTurn.description: Uses a small model to decide when you have finished speaking, so Vox can reply sooner. Audio is held in memory during a turn and is not saved.
smartTurn.fallbackNote: The model is not installed, so Vox uses the fixed silence rule.
smartTurn.modelDescription: One-time download of about {{size}}. It runs on this computer.
smartTurn.modelDescriptionPending: One-time download. It runs on this computer.

latency.heading: Latency panel
latency.label: Show latency panel
latency.description: Shows timing numbers for each turn of a conversation. Numbers only: no audio or text is stored.
latency.placeholder: Waiting for the first turn of a conversation.
latency.samples: Median and 90th percentile over the last {{count}} turns.

persona.heading: Personas
persona.label: Persona
persona.description: A preset of reply style and voice. Applying a persona sets both at once.

error.name_too_long: The name can be at most {{max}} characters.
error.style_too_long: The style can be at most {{max}} characters.
error.unknown_voice: Choose a voice from the list.
error.limit_reached: You can save up to {{max}} custom personas. Delete one to add another.
error.generic: The persona could not be saved. Try again.

speaker.heading: Speaker filter
speaker.label: Speaker filter
speaker.description: Ignore speech that does not sound like your enrolled voice.

disclosure.lead: The speaker filter is a convenience filter. It is not security and it is not authentication.
disclosure.detail: It can wrongly ignore your own voice, and a recording or a similar voice can get through. Your voiceprint stays on this computer, in a file only your account can read. No audio is kept. The filter is off by default.

speaker.inactiveNote: The filter stays inactive until the speaker model is installed and your voice is enrolled.
speaker.sensitivityDescription: How strictly speech from other voices is kept out.

sensitivity.lenientHint: Lets more voices through, and wrongly ignores you less often.
sensitivity.balancedHint: The default, a middle ground between the two.
sensitivity.strictHint: Keeps out more other voices, and wrongly ignores you more often.

speaker.modelDescription: One-time download of about {{size}}. It runs on this computer.
speaker.notEnrolled: Your voice is not enrolled yet.

enroll.label: Enroll your voice
enroll.description: Three short recordings of about 6 seconds each. Speak normally in a quiet place.
enroll.intro: You will read three short sets of sentences. Only the voiceprint is kept, never the audio.
enroll.readThese: Read these sentences in your normal voice:
enroll.allRecorded: All three recordings are in. Finish to save your voiceprint.

messages.busy: Stop the conversation or dictation first.
messages.too_little_speech: Speak a little longer. Vox needs at least 2 seconds of speech for each recording.
messages.inconsistent: The three recordings did not sound alike. Starting again from the first recording.
messages.session_ended: The enrollment ended. Start again when you are ready.
messages.generic: Enrollment did not work. Try again.

prompts.s1a: The quick brown fox jumps over the lazy dog.
prompts.s1b: Please open my calendar and tell me what is on today.
prompts.s1c: What is the weather like this afternoon?
prompts.s2a: Turn the volume down a little, please.
prompts.s2b: Tell me a short fact about the moon.
prompts.s2c: I would like a cup of tea by the window.
prompts.s3a: Remind me to call my sister tomorrow morning.
prompts.s3b: Read the latest message from my team.
prompts.s3c: Thank you, that is all for now.

speaker.deleteDescription: Removes the stored voiceprint. Without one, the speaker filter cannot run.
speaker.deleteConfirm: Delete the voiceprint? You will need to enroll again to use the filter.
speaker.deleteError: The voiceprint could not be deleted. Try again.
